notes.title: Minor bug fixes + Halloween Sale
notes.notes:
Hi!

Today we have a very quick update for you folks. The latest game patch is now available for download with small minor bug fixes. The update primarily improves the support of Valve Index VR goggles, with which a group of players had a problem. Remember, that you can report any bugs via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/916100/discussions/]Telefrag forum[/url] on Steam (Community Hub) or our [url=https://discord.gg/y6Gz5HN]Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33524742/13eaf6081c44a05bbafc7fc6fef0c28ec3cdba81.png[/img]

Also, the new track on The Labirynth map is now implemented. Get familiar with the new arena  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/916100/announcements/detail/1567741951081298329]HERE[/url].


Besides, [b]Telefrag VR[/b] has been discounted by 30% during the Halloween Sale on Steam :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33524742/6c9b9180eae913bd23187915fc17c05f1b81b2a9.png[/img]

notes.title: Telefrag VR - Steam Page Update
notes.notes:
Hi! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/315912b28567c6cfc687522bfa6bcabea2cdf1fe.png[/img]

We've just updated [b]Telefrag VR[/b] Steam Page. Check out the latest assets from the game, including seven new screenshots. Besides Fallen Champion, you can see the first few shots from the new map that we will bring you closer in the next week, here on [i]News[/i] feed.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/6ab2d03cdca194ff80bf86f916a744e491e91ff3.png[/img]


Get familiar with the game pillars and core features in the description and make sure you added the game to your Wishlist because soon we will be ready to share with you some great stuff. You can't miss that! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/][h1][b]ADD THE GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST[/b][/h1][/url]

Also, on the [i]Guide[/i] tab, you can find The Basics tutorial. This guide will walk you through the basics of Telefrag VR and get you acquainted with game mechanics. Find more details about the movement system, weapons and their firing modes, items available on the player HUD and in-game indicators. Click the Plasma Rifle below to see the article.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1673174205][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/2a26440bdc1281a49dc3b279c760468e8fd7fb01.png[/img][/url]

[i]Better be prepared for the fight before the gates of the arenas are opened[/i]
